I completely understand the pain and anger you must be feeling, and I want you to know that my apologies are not just empty words, but a genuine expression of my remorse. I know that words alone cannot undo the harm that has been done, but I want you to know that I am willing to do whatever it takes to make things right. I also want to acknowledge your feelings and perspectives. You are justified in feeling angry, hurt, and disappointed, and I want to validate your experiences. I am also committed to changing my behavior and becoming a better person, so that I can ensure that something like this never happens again. Once again, I want to express my deepest apologies for the pain and suffering that I have caused.
